release_read.basis: Adjusted loss of $(0.60) misses Nasdaq's $(0.55) forecast and the FY adjusted operating margin guide of (4.5)%-(6.5)% confirms the fuel-driven cut; against that Q3 RASM +18.4%, a Q4 RASM guide of +18-22% with 1-2 pts of margin expansion and $2.2B liquidity plus $250M new aircraft financing defuse the distress thesis, so a small negative skew on a name with a 21% implied move.

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 8 estimates)

key_line.detail: Q4 RASM +18% to +22%, CASM ex-fuel -1% to +1%, 1-2 pts YoY margin expansion; liquidity $2.2B incl. $600M undrawn RCF, $250M aircraft financing to fund in Q4, ~$7B unencumbered assets; management: liquidity and financing options 'to create a strong bridge'.

guidance.detail: FY26 adjusted operating margin (4.5)% to (6.5)% at $3.95/gal fuel; Q4 fuel $4.64/gal. Prior FY guide not stated in the release; the hunt expected a fuel-driven FY cut. Q4 RASM guide strong.

call.detail: Call at 10:00 ET, inside the session, not yet held; questions on the creditor co-op and refinancing are the risk an open exit avoids.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched for lack of time before the 09:24 compile; no analyst actions recorded.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 2.7601 (+16.46% vs prev close 2.37), 145 prints, 31 in the last 30 minutes, last print 09:15, not stale; trading near the pre-market high 2.7722 (low 2.50). The move is far above my frozen release read of -2% and about three quarters of the 21% implied move: the market reads the Q4 RASM guide and liquidity as a distress relief, with a 27% short float likely covering.

thesis_check.note: The long thesis rested on documented liquidity far above the covenant and peer RASM strength against a certain FY cut; the release confirms liquidity ($2.2B + $250M financing) and RASM strength, the FY cut came as expected.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market at the high of its range, so the open should hold the move; a 16% gap in a sub-$3 heavily shorted name tends to give some back in the first half hour, and the 10:00 call adds two-way risk.

recommendation.reason: De positie staat voorbeurs al ongeveer 19% in de plus, veel meer dan de cijfers zelf rechtvaardigen (verlies per aandeel iets slechter dan verwacht, jaarprognose omlaag). Grote openingssprongen geven vaak een deel terug, en om 10:00 begint het gesprek met analisten, waar vragen over schulden en schuldeisers kunnen opduiken. Verkoop bij de opening en neem de winst.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 nog duidelijk verder oploopt boven 2,77 met actieve handel en er komen koersdoelverhogingen van analisten binnen, dan is vasthouden tot 13:00 te verdedigen.
